title: Onye Enyi nke Gbapụrụ
intro: Ị na-achọ ịchọpụta akụkọ banyere otu mkpụrụ obi nke biri n'onyinyo nke ịbụ onye amụma mana ọ họọrọ ụzọ nke dugara na mbibi. Onye a bi n'ụlọ ya na otu n'ime ndị ozi Allah họpụtara mana ọ dara ule nke okwukwe. Ònye bụ enyi a furu efu?
clues: Ebi m n'etiti ndị jụrụ oku maka ezi omume, emegideghịkwa m ha.
Alụmdi na nwunye m bụ onye amụma Allah, mana enweghị m otu echiche ahụ.
Mgbe ndị ozi bịara n'ụlọ m na ịdọ aka ná ntị, ekweghị m ha.
E nyere di m ma ọ bụ nwunye m iwu ka ọ pụọ n'obodo ahụ ya na ndị kwere ekwe, mụ onwe m esoghịkwa ha.
Ntaramahụhụ ahụ dakwasịrị ndị m, e bibikwara m na ha.
A kpọtụrụ m aha n'ime Quran dịka ihe atụ nke ekweghị ekwe, tinyere nwunye Nuh, na Surah At-Tahrim.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ọ raara di ya nye site n'ekweghị ekwe
Ọ jụrụ ozi nke onye amụma Hud
Na-efe arụsị n'ihu ọha na Kaaba
A kpara nkata megide ọrụ di ya
Ọ jụrụ ịnakwere ịbụ onye amụma nwa ya nwoke
trial.answer: Ọ raara di ya nye site n'ekweghị ekwe

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A zọpụtara ya na di ya
E bibiri ya na ndị na-ekweghị ekwe
A chụpụrụ ya n'ala dị anya
M mechara bụrụ onye kwere ekwe
outcome.answer: E bibiri ya na ndị na-ekweghị ekwe

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
